history.body: Hey, your Pearl Residences ad came up. Just browsing for now — what’s the starting price and what’s the main appeal?

As a starting reference, it’s about RM302k after the documented rebate on an eligible category’s base price; the selected unit’s car-park and other costs can change the total. The main appeal is a practical 900 sq ft layout with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony—one room could be useful as a guest or work space, if that suits you. Are you browsing for your own stay or mainly as an investment?

More own stay, if anything — I’m not planning a move right now. Three bedrooms at that price is more space than I expected, but I’d be careful about the monthly commitment on one income. I’ll have a think about it.

That’s a sensible thing to weigh on one income. For the 900 sq ft unit, maintenance is RM0.18 per sq ft inclusive of sinking fund—about RM162 a month. The loan instalment is separate and depends on your financing, so I wouldn’t guess at it. The three bedrooms give you flexibility if your needs change, and there’s no need to rush while you’re not planning a move. If you later want to explore affordability, I can work through an indicative instalment using your preferred down payment and tenure.
